summary: Round 2 closes the one blocking finding without introducing a regression. NEXT_STEPS.md no longer has the 'existing network inspection' sentence or the broken hardware.md section link. Line 13 now only says to verify the actual client/LNet configuration rather than assume all four NICs carry filesystem traffic, which needs no archived source. The rest of NEXT_STEPS (arithmetic, IOR/C++/S plan, queue and storage caveats, and the published-method qualifications) is the same content checked in round 1. The manifest's NEXT_STEPS entry has a refreshed record (3738 bytes, sha256 1a2d1340...). catalog.json stores no hash of the manifest or NEXT_STEPS, so nothing further down needs regenerating. A search of psana/psana/gpu finds no remaining reference to the removed claim or anchor. The main report, data and scripts were out of this round's change scope, and the round 1 checks still apply. CLOSEOUT-REVIEW-RECORD stays open as a non-blocking item: review.md and the manifest review/lifecycle fields are still placeholders. The coordinator's plan to record this verdict in an evidence-only commit and rerun the verifiers before pushing is acceptable.
